candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.greeting: Dear Black Semiconductor Data & AI team,
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in Data & AI. Testing data and ML platforms, building knowledge graphs and working with LLM tools are all things I have done in projects, and I would like to bring them to a deep-tech company.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. Before my Master's I built data pipelines and data models on SAP platforms at TallyMarks Consulting.

achievements.impact: in a team project I extracted subject-relation-object triples from text into a knowledge graph and compared graph-based and language-model embeddings
I built DocuMind, a RAG application with the Claude API that answered 91% of a 22-question test set correctly, with tests, CI and clear documentation
I designed SAP Datasphere data pipelines and validated data with SQL during a 42-dashboard migration

letter.problems_section: I would help set up and test platforms, structure ontologies, configure LLM tools, prepare data and document my work so others can reuse it. I have not configured agentic platforms yet, and I would learn them with your mentor.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Aachen and can work up to 20 hours per week, starting immediately. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
